Name: Change Into Swimsuit
Author: gayannabeth
Description:
[size=4]For mod authors:
[/size][size=3]During Events:
[/size]To change the player into their swimsuit, use the following command:
[code]﻿changeIntoSwimsuit[/code]
To change back into normal clothes, use:
[code]﻿changeOutOfSwimsuit
[/code]
[b]*NOTE*[/b]: if you do not make sure the player changes back into normal clothes after the event, they will still be in their swimsuit. You can do this by ending the event with changeOutOfSwimsuit or changeIntoSwimsuit and by including the ChangeOutOfSwimsuit or ChangeIntoSwimsuit trigger actions in setSkipActions.

[size=3]Tile/Trigger Actions:
[/size]The tile actions are both named
[code]﻿ChangeIntoSwimsuit
[/code]
and
[code]﻿ChangeOutOfSwimsuit
[/code]
Addtionally, there are two separate trigger actions for swimming:
[code]﻿StartSwimming <farmer or NPC name>
StopSwimming <farmer or NPC name>[/code]
which toggle a player or NPC being in the swimming state
[size=3]Source code:
[/size]Source code for this mod can be found at: https://github.com/gayannabeth/ChangeIntoSwimsuit
